recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-11464; future data-element guidance should remain aligned with StructureDefinition logical-model guidance rather than the retired DataElement resource.
issue_request: FHIR-11464 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core conformance-module ballot correction for DSTU2. It said the roadmap should not characterize DataElement as mature because DataElement had not been well tested and SDC had not rigorously exercised it.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite svn revision 10271. The matching git-svn commit ba8eb01c7c39e3343c75d60fbb0ecffce7630d10 removed DataElement from the mature conformance-resource list in source/conformance-module.html and added it to the still-under-development list with a note that the role of data element definitions was still being studied.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-13094 collapsed DataElement into StructureDefinition logical models. Historical commit d0802c9b75a4705416fe7f8c601c46dfa2ed8892 removed DataElement references from the conformance module, and the combined branch already contains c1a07840fdc89786d1b71cdd5f635e9032155d72 for FHIR-13094 cleanup. Current combined source has no DataElement maturity claim in source/conformance-module.html and keeps DataElement commented out in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already reflects the FHIR-11464 correction, and adding any new DataElement maturity wording would be stale after the later DataElement-to-StructureDefinition decision.

related_jiras.note: Later Published decision collapsed DataElement into StructureDefinition logical models, superseding any current need for DataElement maturity text in the conformance roadmap; it is already represented on the combined branch.
